tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

3	part 'failure.freezed.dart';
4	
5	/// AD-3 — the one closed `Failure` hierarchy, exactly 14 subtypes: the 13
6	/// codes from `docs/input/backend/error-taxonomy.md` plus the local-only
7	/// `malformedResponse` (client-side parse failure, never sent by the
8	/// backend). Never redefined or subset per feature; every repository method
9	/// returns `Either<Failure, T>` built from this type (RNF09).
10	///
11	/// `retryable` is derived here, once, from the 6 server `retryable:true`
12	/// codes (AD-4) — no other file re-decides which codes retry.
13	@freezed
14	sealed class Failure with _$Failure {
15	  const factory Failure.authExpired({required String message}) = AuthExpired;
16	  const factory Failure.authInvalid({required String message}) = AuthInvalid;
17	  const factory Failure.networkTimeout({required String message}) =
18	      NetworkTimeout;
19	  const factory Failure.networkOffline({required String message}) =
20	      NetworkOffline;
21	  const factory Failure.validation({required String message}) = Validation;
22	  const factory Failure.piiCheckFailed({required String message}) =
23	      PiiCheckFailed;
24	  const factory Failure.embeddingFailed({required String message}) =
25	      EmbeddingFailed;
26	  const factory Failure.aiGenerationTimeout({required String message}) =
27	      AiGenerationTimeout;
28	  const factory Failure.notFound({required String message}) = NotFound;
29	  const factory Failure.rateLimited({required String message}) = RateLimited;
30	  const factory Failure.exportEmptyPeriod({required String message}) =
31	      ExportEmptyPeriod;
32	  const factory Failure.payloadTooLarge({required String message}) =
33	      PayloadTooLarge;
34	  const factory Failure.ocrNoText({required String message}) = OcrNoText;
35	
36	  /// Local-only — the client's own parse-failure detection. `retryable` is
37	  /// hardcoded `false` for this subtype (AD-3).
38	  const factory Failure.malformedResponse({required String message}) =
39	      MalformedResponse;
40	
41	  const Failure._();
42	
43	  /// The 6 server `retryable:true` codes (AD-4). Every other code —
44	  /// including the local `malformedResponse` — is `false`.
45	  bool get retryable => switch (this) {
46	        NetworkTimeout() => true,
47	        NetworkOffline() => true,
48	        PiiCheckFailed() => true,
49	        EmbeddingFailed() => true,
50	        AiGenerationTimeout() => true,
51	        RateLimited() => true,
52	        AuthExpired() ||
53	        AuthInvalid() ||
54	        Validation() ||
55	        NotFound() ||
56	        ExportEmptyPeriod() ||
57	        PayloadTooLarge() ||
58	        OcrNoText() ||
59	        MalformedResponse() =>
60	          false,
61	      };
62	
63	  /// Maps a backend error `code` (`error-taxonomy.md`) to its `Failure`
64	  /// subtype. An unrecognized code (should never happen — the taxonomy is
65	  /// closed) falls back to [Failure.malformedResponse] rather than throwing,
66	  /// so no repository ever lets an unmapped error escape (RNF09).
67	  factory Failure.fromCode(String code, String message) => switch (code) {
68	        'AUTH_EXPIRED' => Failure.authExpired(message: message),
69	        'AUTH_INVALID' => Failure.authInvalid(message: message),
70	        'NETWORK_TIMEOUT' => Failure.networkTimeout(message: message),
71	        'NETWORK_OFFLINE' => Failure.networkOffline(message: message),
72	        'VALIDATION_ERROR' => Failure.validation(message: message),
73	        'PII_CHECK_FAILED' => Failure.piiCheckFailed(message: message),
74	        'EMBEDDING_FAILED' => Failure.embeddingFailed(message: message),
75	        'AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT' =>
76	          Failure.aiGenerationTimeout(message: message),
77	        'NOT_FOUND' => Failure.notFound(message: message),
78	        'RATE_LIMITED' => Failure.rateLimited(message: message),
79	        'EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD' => Failure.exportEmptyPeriod(message: message),
80	        'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE' => Failure.payloadTooLarge(message: message),
81	        'OCR_NO_TEXT' => Failure.ocrNoText(message: message),
82	        _ => Failure.malformedResponse(message: message),
83	      };
84	}

7	/// Registers the `account` feature into the project's single `get_it`

9	/// pattern. Called from `setupCoreDependencies()` right after
10	/// `registerVaultFeature()` (Code Map).
11	void registerAccountFeature() {
12	  sl.registerLazySingleton<AccountRemoteDataSource>(
13	    () => AccountRemoteDataSource(sl()),
14	  );

16	  // The epic's one new DI-singleton access point for the account's
17	  // `biometricEnabled` preference — registered as a singleton so every
18	  // consumer (`main.dart`'s boot fetch; `core/navigation/app_router.dart`'s
19	  // `/vault` builder; the Configurações screen's own cubit) shares the same
20	  // `biometricEnabledStream`, not a fresh instance each. `dispose:` wires
21	  // `AccountSettingsRepository.dispose()` into `get_it`'s own reset
22	  // lifecycle, so `resetCoreDependencies()` (`sl.reset()`) closes its
23	  // `StreamController` instead of leaking one on every test teardown.
24	  sl.registerLazySingleton<AccountSettingsRepository>(
25	    () => AccountSettingsRepositoryImpl(remoteDataSource: sl()),
26	    dispose: (repository) => repository.dispose(),

30	  // `biometricEnabledStream`; only its own `close()` cancels that
31	  // subscription, which nothing previously called — `dispose:` wires it
32	  // into `get_it`'s own reset lifecycle, same convention as every other
33	  // registration in this file.
34	  sl.registerLazySingleton<AccountSettingsCubit>(

7	/// centered card; neutral title (session) or red title (destructive
8	/// deletion)"). Story 1.5 is the first consumer (neutral `colorTextPrimary`
9	/// title, the session-expiry recovery copy); a later story (Epic 8's
10	/// account-deletion confirm) reuses this same widget with [titleColor]
11	/// set to `DesignTokens.colorError` and a heavier [barrierColor].
12	///

14	/// `scrimIn` (0.18s ease-out fade) as the only entrance choreography, and
15	/// at most one instance open at a time — [show] is the one way this
16	/// widget is ever presented, and owns that single-overlay guard itself so
17	/// no caller has to re-implement it.
18	class ConfirmationDialog extends StatelessWidget {
19	  const ConfirmationDialog({
20	    super.key,
21	    required this.icon,
22	    required this.title,
23	    required this.message,
24	    required this.confirmLabel,

38	  /// `DesignTokens.colorScrim` (session-expiry, Story 1.5) or the heavier
39	  /// drawer/sheet value a later story uses for its own confirmation.

50	  /// posição do scroll são preservados"). Optional — a future destructive

55	  /// (UX-DR16/25/27/36: "never stacks on another open overlay"). Exposed

57	  static bool isOpen = false;

input.message:
Implemented spec-3-1 (Text Entry Capture & Insertion Modal Shell) in full. All frontmatter `context:` was empty, so I read the spec itself plus every file/area named in its Code Map before starting.

## What was built

**`entries` feature** (new):
- `lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart` — `Entry` plain class + `EntrySource` enum, mirrors `AuthenticatedUser`.
- `lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart` — abstract `EntriesRepository.create({content, source}) -> Either<Failure, Entry>`.
- `lib/features/entries/data/models/entry_dto.dart` (+ generated `entry_dto.g.dart`) — `@JsonSerializable()` DTO; `EntrySource` round-trips via its own `.name`.
- `lib/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart` — posts `{content, source}` to `entries-create` via `ApiClient.post`.
- `lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart` — on success, writes `EntryDto.toJson()` to the `entries` Hive `Box<Map>` keyed by id *before* returning `Right`; a Hive write exception maps to `Failure.malformedResponse` (RNF09).
- `lib/features/entries/entries_injection.dart` — opens the Hive box, registers datasource/repository.

**`capture` feature** (new):
- `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/text_entry_cubit.dart` — `CaptureTab` enum + a hand-written sealed `TextEntryState` (Idle/Saving/Saved/Error, never the shared `Resource<T>`), `TextEntryCubit` calling `EntriesRepository.create` directly (no use-case layer, per Design Notes).
- `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart` — the 3-tab bottom sheet. `InsertionModal.show()` uses `showModalBottomSheet(isScrollControlled: true, barrierColor: colorScrimHeavy)`, a `radiusLg`-top/`elevation2` `Container` (Material elevation set to 0, same convention as `ConfirmationDialog`'s card), and a `durationSheetUp` entrance via a custom `transitionAnimationController` that collapses to `Duration.zero` under `MediaQuery.disableAnimations`. Texto tab is fully functional; Áudio/Foto render idle placeholders only.
- `lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart` — registers `TextEntryCubit` as a **factory** (not a singleton), so every "+" tap gets a fresh instance ("Modal open resets").

**Wiring**:
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` — added `durationSheetUp = Duration(milliseconds: 200)`.
- `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` — added `Hive.initFlutter()` + `registerEntriesFeature()` + `registerCaptureFeature()` after `registerAccountFeature()`.
- `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart` — `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` gained a `FloatingActionButton` ("+" , always tappable, `colorAccent`/`colorOnAccent`) that calls `InsertionModal.show(context, cubit: sl<TextEntryCubit>())`.

## A real bug I hit and fixed

Supplying a custom `transitionAnimationController` to `showModalBottomSheet` means **you** own disposal — but `showModalBottomSheet`'s returned `Future` resolves as soon as `Navigator.pop()` is called, *before* the framework's own `reverse()` exit animation on that same controller finishes. My first version disposed the controller immediately in a `finally` block, which killed the ticker mid-animation and froze the sheet on screen forever (reproduced and confirmed via a throwaway diagnostic test before fixing). Fixed by waiting for `AnimationStatus.dismissed` before disposing, and also collapsing `reverseDuration` to zero under Reduce Motion.

## Tests added

- `test/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source_test.dart` (incl. the `runWriteFailureMatrix` helper for `entries-create`)
- `test/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl_test.dart` (Hive write success/failure, mocked `Box<Map>`)
- `test/features/capture/presentation/cubit/text_entry_cubit_test.dart`
- `test/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal_test.dart` (full I/O matrix against the real widget: happy path, offline/failure, cancel-via-"x", Reduce Motion)
- `test/core/navigation/placeholder_screens_test.dart` — new case for the "+" control
- `test/core/di/bootstrap_integration_test.dart` and `test/main_test.dart` extended to cover the new DI chain

**Infra note**: `setupCoreDependencies()` now calls `Hive.initFlutter()`, which transitively needs `path_provider`. Added `test/support/fake_path_provider_platform.dart` (a `PathProviderPlatform` override returning a temp dir) and wired it into both `bootstrap_integration_test.dart` and `main_test.dart`, plus `Hive.close()` in their `tearDown` (otherwise a box opened in one test leaks into the next, since Hive silently returns an already-open box rather than reopening at a new path). Added `path_provider_platform_interface` as a dev dependency for this.

## Verification

- `fvm flutter pub get` — resolved, no conflicts.
- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` — generated `entry_dto.g.dart` cleanly.
- `fvm flutter analyze` — zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` — **394 tests, all passing** (full suite, including the pre-existing suites I touched for DI/Hive wiring).

## Boundaries honored (double-checked)

- `grep` confirms `features/capture/` never imports `entries/data` or `entries/presentation`.
- `entries/domain` imports neither `flutter` nor `data/`.
- No Áudio/Foto capture logic — idle placeholders only.
- No `GET /entries`, no extra `Entry` fields beyond the 8 named.
- "+" is a bare FAB, not the RF04 composer.
- No connectivity service/offline banner was added.

## Risks / things worth a second look

- The FAB on `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` is my own visual choice (spec didn't specify the exact widget) — a `FloatingActionButton` with `colorAccent`/`colorOnAccent`, sized well above the 44pt floor. If the prototype or a later story expects a different placement/shape, this is the one spot to revisit.
- `EntriesRepository.create` takes only `{content, source}` — I deliberately left `chatMessageId`/`occurredAt`/`mediaDurationSeconds` out of the port signature since this story never needs them; Stories 3.2/3.3/RF10 will need to decide whether to extend this method's signature or add overloads.

Implemented spec-3-1 (Text Entry Capture & Insertion Modal Shell) in full. All frontmatter `context:` was empty, so I read the spec itself plus every file/area named in its Code Map before starting.

## What was built

**`entries` feature** (new):
- `lib/features/entries/domain/entities/entry.dart` — `Entry` plain class + `EntrySource` enum, mirrors `AuthenticatedUser`.
- `lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart` — abstract `EntriesRepository.create({content, source}) -> Either<Failure, Entry>`.
- `lib/features/entries/data/models/entry_dto.dart` (+ generated `entry_dto.g.dart`) — `@JsonSerializable()` DTO; `EntrySource` round-trips via its own `.name`.
- `lib/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart` — posts `{content, source}` to `entries-create` via `ApiClient.post`.
- `lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart` — on success, writes `EntryDto.toJson()` to the `entries` Hive `Box<Map>` keyed by id *before* returning `Right`; a Hive write exception maps to `Failure.malformedResponse` (RNF09).
- `lib/features/entries/entries_injection.dart` — opens the Hive box, registers datasource/repository.

**`capture` feature** (new):
- `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/text_entry_cubit.dart` — `CaptureTab` enum + a hand-written sealed `TextEntryState` (Idle/Saving/Saved/Error, never the shared `Resource<T>`), `TextEntryCubit` calling `EntriesRepository.create` directly (no use-case layer, per Design Notes).
- `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart` — the 3-tab bottom sheet. `InsertionModal.show()` uses `showModalBottomSheet(isScrollControlled: true, barrierColor: colorScrimHeavy)`, a `radiusLg`-top/`elevation2` `Container` (Material elevation set to 0, same convention as `ConfirmationDialog`'s card), and a `durationSheetUp` entrance via a custom `transitionAnimationController` that collapses to `Duration.zero` under `MediaQuery.disableAnimations`. Texto tab is fully functional; Áudio/Foto render idle placeholders only.
- `lib/features/capture/capture_injection.dart` — registers `TextEntryCubit` as a **factory** (not a singleton), so every "+" tap gets a fresh instance ("Modal open resets").

**Wiring**:
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` — added `durationSheetUp = Duration(milliseconds: 200)`.
- `lib/core/di/injection_container.dart` — added `Hive.initFlutter()` + `registerEntriesFeature()` + `registerCaptureFeature()` after `registerAccountFeature()`.
- `lib/core/navigation/placeholder_screens.dart` — `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` gained a `FloatingActionButton` ("+" , always tappable, `colorAccent`/`colorOnAccent`) that calls `InsertionModal.show(context, cubit: sl<TextEntryCubit>())`.

## A real bug I hit and fixed

Supplying a custom `transitionAnimationController` to `showModalBottomSheet` means **you** own disposal — but `showModalBottomSheet`'s returned `Future` resolves as soon as `Navigator.pop()` is called, *before* the framework's own `reverse()` exit animation on that same controller finishes. My first version disposed the controller immediately in a `finally` block, which killed the ticker mid-animation and froze the sheet on screen forever (reproduced and confirmed via a throwaway diagnostic test before fixing). Fixed by waiting for `AnimationStatus.dismissed` before disposing, and also collapsing `reverseDuration` to zero under Reduce Motion.

## Tests added

- `test/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source_test.dart` (incl. the `runWriteFailureMatrix` helper for `entries-create`)
- `test/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl_test.dart` (Hive write success/failure, mocked `Box<Map>`)
- `test/features/capture/presentation/cubit/text_entry_cubit_test.dart`
- `test/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal_test.dart` (full I/O matrix against the real widget: happy path, offline/failure, cancel-via-"x", Reduce Motion)
- `test/core/navigation/placeholder_screens_test.dart` — new case for the "+" control
- `test/core/di/bootstrap_integration_test.dart` and `test/main_test.dart` extended to cover the new DI chain

**Infra note**: `setupCoreDependencies()` now calls `Hive.initFlutter()`, which transitively needs `path_provider`. Added `test/support/fake_path_provider_platform.dart` (a `PathProviderPlatform` override returning a temp dir) and wired it into both `bootstrap_integration_test.dart` and `main_test.dart`, plus `Hive.close()` in their `tearDown` (otherwise a box opened in one test leaks into the next, since Hive silently returns an already-open box rather than reopening at a new path). Added `path_provider_platform_interface` as a dev dependency for this.

## Verification

- `fvm flutter pub get` — resolved, no conflicts.
- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` — generated `entry_dto.g.dart` cleanly.
- `fvm flutter analyze` — zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` — **394 tests, all passing** (full suite, including the pre-existing suites I touched for DI/Hive wiring).

## Boundaries honored (double-checked)

- `grep` confirms `features/capture/` never imports `entries/data` or `entries/presentation`.
- `entries/domain` imports neither `flutter` nor `data/`.
- No Áudio/Foto capture logic — idle placeholders only.
- No `GET /entries`, no extra `Entry` fields beyond the 8 named.
- "+" is a bare FAB, not the RF04 composer.
- No connectivity service/offline banner was added.

## Risks / things worth a second look

- The FAB on `HomeChatPlaceholderScreen` is my own visual choice (spec didn't specify the exact widget) — a `FloatingActionButton` with `colorAccent`/`colorOnAccent`, sized well above the 44pt floor. If the prototype or a later story expects a different placement/shape, this is the one spot to revisit.
- `EntriesRepository.create` takes only `{content, source}` — I deliberately left `chatMessageId`/`occurredAt`/`mediaDurationSeconds` out of the port signature since this story never needs them; Stories 3.2/3.3/RF10 will need to decide whether to extend this method's signature or add overloads.
- `occurredAt`/`createdAt`/`updatedAt` are kept as raw ISO-8601 strings (not parsed to `DateTime`) on both the DTO and the domain `Entry` — a deliberate, documented simplicity choice since nothing reads them yet.

The coordinator sent a message while you were working:
Code review of your Story 3.1 diff is done (three parallel reviewers: blind-hunter, edge-case-hunter, verification-gap). Nine findings were classified as "patch" — real, trivially fixable, no spec change needed. Apply all nine, then re-run the spec's Verification commands (`fvm flutter analyze`, `fvm flutter test`) and confirm they still pass.

1. **Race: tab switch / close during in-flight save.** `_TabButton.onTap` (calls `TextEntryCubit.selectTab`) and `_CloseButton.onTap` in `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart` are never disabled while `state is TextEntrySaving`. A user can switch to Áudio/Foto or tap "x" mid-save; when the stale `save()` call later resolves, it emits `TextEntrySaved`/`TextEntryError` keyed to the tab/text captured at call time, which can pop the modal unexpectedly or show an error against a tab the user has since left. Fix: disable the tab bar's `InkWell.onTap` and the close button's `onTap` while `TextEntrySaving` (same pattern already used for the Texto `TextField`'s `enabled: !isSaving`).

2. **Cubit-level guard for the same race.** `TextEntryCubit.selectTab` (`lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/text_entry_cubit.dart`) should also no-op when `state is TextEntrySaving`, as defense in depth alongside fix #1's UI-level disable.

3. **Missing announcements.** `_InsertionModalBodyState._announce`'s doc comment claims "every state change this story introduces is spoken explicitly here," but the listener's switch in `insertion_modal.dart` only announces `TextEntrySaving`/`TextEntryError` — `TextEntrySaved` (save success) and tab switches (which re-emit `TextEntryIdle`) fall to `break;` with no announcement. This contradicts the story's own Acceptance Criteria ("any state change... an announced label accompanies it — never color/animation alone"). Fix: add an announcement for `TextEntrySaved` (e.g. "Registro salvo") and for a tab switch (e.g. announce the newly active tab's label), and correct the doc comment to match actual coverage.

4. **No test verifies any announcement actually fires.** `test/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal_test.dart` never asserts on `SemanticsService`/the accessibility channel — only on visible `Text`/`TextField`/button state. This codebase already has a working pattern for this: `interceptAnnouncements()` in `test/features/vault/presentation/screens/vault_lock_screen_test.dart` (intercepts the `flutter/accessibility` platform channel to capture real announcement strings). Reuse that pattern (extract to a shared test helper if convenient) and add assertions for the Saving/Error/Saved/tab-switch announcements from fix #3.

5. **Hive write-through only tested against an always-succeeding mock.** `test/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl_test.dart` uses `class MockBox extends Mock implements Box<Map> {}` with `when(() => mockBox.put(any(), any())).thenAnswer((_) async {})` — this never exercises real `hive_ce` encoding of the actual `EntryDto.toJson()` shape (enum, nullable field, ints, ISO date strings). Add an integration-style test under `test/features/entries/` that opens a real temp-dir-backed box (same `FakePathProviderPlatform`/`Hive.initFlutter()` setup already used in `test/core/di/bootstrap_integration_test.dart`), constructs `EntriesRepositoryImpl` with a fake `EntriesRemoteDataSource` returning `Right(EntryDto)`, calls `create()`, then asserts `box.get(id)` round-trips the expected map.

6. **Prototype copy mismatch.** `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart`'s `_TextoTab` uses `hintText: 'Escreva seu registro...'`. The frozen prototype reference (`docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md:77`) specifies the Texto tab's placeholder as exactly `"Escreva livremente..."`. Fix the literal string to match — verified directly against that line, this is not ambiguous.

7. **No client-side length bound on the Texto field.** The backend's `POST /entries` `content` field is capped at `maxLength: 20000` (`docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml`). The `TextField` in `_TextoTab` has no `maxLength`, so a user can type past the backend's limit and get an avoidable round-trip failure. Add `maxLength: 20000` to that `TextField` to mirror the documented backend limit exactly (don't invent a different number).

8. **Redundant `.gitkeep` files.** `lib/features/entries/data/.gitkeep`, `lib/features/entries/domain/.gitkeep`, and `lib/features/capture/presentation/.gitkeep` are now redundant — their directories contain populated subdirectories with real files (`data/datasources/`, `data/models/`, `data/repositories/`, `presentation/cubit/`, `presentation/widgets/`). Delete these three `.gitkeep` files.

9. **Test-infra leak.** `test/support/fake_path_provider_platform.dart`'s `getApplicationDocumentsPath()` creates a brand-new temp directory via `Directory.systemTemp.createTempSync(...)` on every call and never deletes it — every test run that exercises DI bootstrap (most of them, directly or via `main_test.dart`/`bootstrap_integration_test.dart`) now leaks an orphaned temp folder on the dev machine/CI runner. Fix: clean up the created temp directory (e.g. in a `tearDown`/`tearDownAll` that deletes it, or have the fake delete-on-next-use).

Five additional findings were classified as "defer" (real but not blocking, logged to `deferred-work.md` for later — no action needed from you): plaintext storage in the entries Hive box with no encryption at rest, the `Box<Map>` DI registration having no `instanceName` (will collide with the next feature's own box), no per-user namespacing/clear-on-logout for the entries box, the FAB's visual divergence from the prototype's composer-embedded "+", and swipe/barrier-dismiss still being able to close the sheet mid-save. You don't need to touch these.

When done, report what you changed for each of the 9 patches and confirm `fvm flutter analyze` / `fvm flutter test` are still clean.

Address this before completing your current task.

15	class InsertionModal extends StatelessWidget {

17	
18	  final TextEntryCubit cubit;
19	
20	  /// Presents the modal exactly as the Boundaries dictate:
21	  /// `showModalBottomSheet(isScrollControlled: true, barrierColor:
22	  /// colorScrimHeavy)`, `radiusLg` top corners + `elevation2` (drawn by
23	  /// this widget's own `Container`, not Material's `elevation` double —
24	  /// same convention `ConfirmationDialog`'s card already uses), and a
25	  /// `durationSheetUp` entrance that collapses to zero under Reduce
26	  /// Motion (`MediaQuery.disableAnimations`).

29	  /// tap (Boundaries: "Modal open resets"), closed here once the sheet is
30	  /// gone, regardless of how it closed (Salvar success, "x", swipe-down,
31	  /// or barrier dismiss) — the caller never has to remember to do this
32	  /// itself.
33	  static Future<void> show(
34	    BuildContext context, {
35	    required TextEntryCubit cubit,
36	  }) async {
37	    final reduceMotion = MediaQuery.of(context).disableAnimations;
38	    final controller =
39	        BottomSheet.createAnimationController(Navigator.of(context))
40	          ..duration = reduceMotion
41	              ? Duration.zero
42	              : DesignTokens.durationSheetUp
43	          // Boundaries only names the entrance, but Reduce Motion should
44	          // collapse the exit the same way — otherwise dismissing the
45	          // sheet would still animate for anyone who asked for no motion.
46	          ..reverseDuration = reduceMotion ? Duration.zero : null;
47	    try {
48	      await showModalBottomSheet<void>(
49	        context: context,
50	        isScrollControlled: true,
51	        barrierColor: DesignTokens.colorScrimHeavy,
52	        backgroundColor: Colors.transparent,
53	        elevation: 0,
54	        transitionAnimationController: controller,
55	        builder: (_) => InsertionModal(cubit: cubit),
56	      );
57	    } finally {
58	      // `showModalBottomSheet`'s own Future completes as soon as the
59	      // route is popped — *before* the exit (`reverse()`) animation the
60	      // framework drives on this same controller actually finishes.
61	      // Disposing immediately would cancel that animation's ticker
62	      // mid-flight, permanently freezing the sheet on screen (its
63	      // `AnimatedBuilder` keeps rendering the controller's last value,
64	      // and the route itself never reaches `AnimationStatus.dismissed`
65	      // to be removed from the `Overlay`). Documented behavior
66	      // (`BottomSheet.transitionAnimationController`'s own doc: "the
67	      // caller is responsible for disposing it when the controller is
68	      // no longer needed") — waiting for `dismissed` first is that
69	      // "no longer needed" point.
70	      if (!controller.isDismissed) {
71	        final animationDone = Completer<void>();
72	        void onStatusChange(AnimationStatus status) {
73	          if (status == AnimationStatus.dismissed) {
74	            animationDone.complete();
75	          }
76	        }
77	
78	        controller.addStatusListener(onStatusChange);
79	        await animationDone.future;
80	        controller.removeStatusListener(onStatusChange);
81	      }
82	      controller.dispose();
83	      await cubit.close();
84	    }
85	  }

### 2.3 Insertion modal (bottom sheet over Home/Chat; 9 states)
Common structure: "x" to close and a 3-tab bar (Texto / Áudio / Foto); the active tab has a filled dark-green background.

|---|---|

| Áudio — Processando | Spinner in place of stop; frozen, faded waveform (opacity .35); text "Transcrevendo..."; label "00:42 de áudio". |
| Áudio — Transcrito | Editable transcribed text; original audio duration in mono; "Salvar" enabled. |
| Áudio — Erro | Red warning icon, "Não foi possível transcrever", outline button "Tentar novamente". |
| Foto — Captura | Two large buttons, "Câmera" and "Galeria". |
| Foto — Processando OCR | Photo thumbnail, spinner, "Reconhecendo texto...". |
| Foto — Reconhecido | Small thumbnail next to the extracted (editable) text; "Salvar". |
| Foto — Erro | Thumbnail kept, warning icon, "Não foi possível reconhecer o texto", button "Tentar novamente" and secondary text action "Salvar só a foto". |

input.message:
All 9 patch-classified findings from the three-reviewer code review are applied. `fvm flutter analyze` is clean and `fvm flutter test` passes (402 tests, up from 394 — net +8 new/expanded tests).

## Patches applied

**1. Race: tab switch/close during in-flight save (UI level)** — `lib/features/capture/presentation/widgets/insertion_modal.dart`: `_TabBar`/`_TabButton`/`_CloseButton` now take an `isSaving` flag computed once in `_InsertionModalBodyState.build` (`state is TextEntrySaving`); each `InkWell.onTap` becomes `null` while saving (same "disabled onTap" convention as `AccountSettingsScreen`'s `Switch`). Covered by a new test: "the tab bar and 'x' are disabled while Salvar is in flight, re-enabled once it resolves."

**2. Cubit-level guard (defense in depth)** — `lib/features/capture/presentation/cubit/text_entry_cubit.dart`: `selectTab` now also no-ops when `state is TextEntrySaving`, not just when the tapped tab is already active.

**3. Missing announcements** — `insertion_modal.dart`'s listener now announces `TextEntrySaved` ("Registro salvo", before popping) and tab switches ("Aba {label} selecionada"), the latter detected via a new `_lastAnnouncedTab` field (initialized in `initState` from the cubit's current state) so it fires only on a genuine tab change, not on every keystroke-driven `TextEntryIdle` re-emission. Doc comment on `_announce` corrected to match actual coverage.

**4. No test verified any announcement fired** — extracted `vault_lock_screen_test.dart`'s local `interceptAnnouncements` helper into `test/support/intercept_announcements.dart` (and updated that original test file to import it instead, dropping its now-unused `flutter/services.dart` import). Added a new `announcements` group to `insertion_modal_test.dart` with 5 tests: tab-switch announcement, no spurious re-announcement while typing, "Salvando registro", "Registro salvo", and the failure message verbatim.

**5. Hive write-through only tested against an always-succeeding mock** — new `test/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl_integration_test.dart`: opens a *real* temp-dir-backed `Box<Map>` (same `FakePathProviderPlatform`/`Hive.initFlutter()` bootstrap as `bootstrap_integration_test.dart`), drives `EntriesRepositoryImpl` with a mocked remote data source, and asserts the stored map's exact shape (enum-as-string, null `chatMessageId`, ints, ISO date strings) plus a full `EntryDto.fromJson` round-trip. A second case covers a non-null `chatMessageId`/`chat` source.

**6. Prototype copy mismatch** — `_TextoTab`'s `hintText` changed from `'Escreva seu registro...'` to the frozen prototype's exact `'Escreva livremente...'` (prototype-extract.md §2.3).

**7. No client-side length bound** — added `maxLength: 20000` to the Texto `TextField`, mirroring `openapi.yaml`'s `content` field cap exactly (shows Flutter's default character counter as a side effect — not suppressed, since that wasn't asked for and is useful feedback).

**8. Redundant `.gitkeep` files** — deleted `lib/features/entries/data/.gitkeep`, `lib/features/entries/domain/.gitkeep`, `lib/features/capture/presentation/.gitkeep` (their directories now hold real files). `lib/features/capture/domain/.gitkeep` was correctly left alone — that directory is still genuinely empty this story.

**9. Test-infra temp-dir leak** — `test/support/fake_path_provider_platform.dart`'s `FakePathProviderPlatform` now tracks every temp dir it creates and exposes `cleanUp()` to delete them; `bootstrap_integration_test.dart` and `main_test.dart` both now hold the instance in a variable and call `cleanUp()` in `tearDown`. Verified post-run: `ls /tmp | grep cerne_test_hive_` returns zero matches.

## Verification

- `fvm flutter analyze` — zero issues.
- `fvm flutter test` — **402 tests, all passing** (full suite).
- Confirmed zero leaked `cerne_test_hive_*` temp directories after the full run.

No other files were touched beyond what the 9 findings required.
